messages:
Sarah (Sales): Quick transfer brief for an account we closed yesterday — Northpoint (mid-market). Signed 12mo Dedicated. Needs: VPC + KMS, Okta SSO, and 99th pct latency target <=600ms. Onboarding ETA ~4w but procurement might push KMS. I created a provisioning ticket `CS-7432`. Finance flagged unit-cost concerns; they want a cost projection. Can CS pick this up and loop Eng/Support for SSO/runbook? :wave:
Maria (CS): Thanks — picking up. Will do kickoff and own the onboarding runbook. Immediate asks: 1) billing contact, 2) Okta admin + test account, 3) network CIDR ranges for VPC. Can you drop those? :+1:
Sarah (Sales): Billing is "Ravi Patel, ravi.p@northpoint.co". Okta admin is "admin@northpoint.co" — I'll intro on email after this. CIDR: customer will provide by EOD tomorrow. Finance rep is "Leah Gomez" if you need to loop unit economics.
Maria (CS): Got it. I'll open an internal playbook checklist and create tasks. Creating CS checklist in Notion: https://notion.redwood/nb/northpoint-onboard — will share once done. Assigned owners: Maria (CS) lead, Kevin (Eng) for SSO, Aj (Support) for runbook/tracing.
Kevin (Eng): Re SSO connector: estimated 5 business days to validate Okta metadata, build config, and run e2e tests on Dedicated. Need Okta metadata file and test admin. Also confirm whether they need Just-in-Time provisioning or SAML only.
Aj (Support): I'll draft the onboarding runbook and add tracing + observability checklist. Will add an alert rule for 95/99 latency buckets and a dashboard template. Creating support ticket `SUP-1986` for runbook tasks.
Maria (CS): For the procurement/KMS risk — OpsBot ran a quick infra check and flagged that private KMS requires a legal addendum in our contract flow. @Sarah (Sales) can you confirm how strong their timeline is? If procurement delays >2w, recommend we spin up temporary key-in-transit using our managed KMS to unblock onboarding (documented tradeoffs).
Sarah (Sales): I'll push procurement; they're motivated but cautious. They asked to see a cost calc before committing to KMS add-on. Can Redwood Optimize run a projection? @Maria can you attach example token/unit calc to show impact on monthly cost?
Maria (CS): Yes — I'll request a cost projection from Optimize and attach to kickoff deck. Action items I have now: create kickoff invite, capture contacts, create onboarding Notion checklist, add `CS-7432` link, create ENG ticket `ENG-9123` for SSO, and SUP ticket `SUP-1986`.
Kevin (Eng): @Maria please include a reproducible test prompt + sample traffic profile (seq len distribution) so we can size GPU config and latency SLOs.
Aj (Support): Also need sample logs and a staging dataset for privacy checks. If they need private deploy later, that'll be a separate path.
Maria (CS): Scheduling kickoff: Thurs 10am PT — send calendar invite?
Sarah (Sales): Confirmed — Thurs 10am PT works for customer. I'll intro all contacts in the invite. :calendar:
Maria (CS): Great — I'll update the Notion runbook and post back with the kickoff agenda and owners. Quick summary of owners and next actions: Maria (CS) — onboarding lead + customer comms; Kevin (Eng) — SSO connector `ENG-9123`; Aj (Support) — runbook + observability `SUP-1986`; Sarah (Sales) — procurement & billing contact. Next check-in after kickoff. :thumbsup:
